items: 【GARDEN TRELLIS ONGOING SUPPORT】Adjustable Height (6.2FT/74.4") is the perfect size to work as a trellis for climbing plants outdoor. This garden trellis can be adjusted by increasing or decreasing the connecting rings based on different plant heights, giving a more adaptable space for plants to grow

【More Creativity】MQUPIN High garden obelisk sides have ribbed particles to help keep ties in place, a tall vertical frame with 4 stakes into soil, better carrying capacity and stability. Also sealed at the tip base to ensure they are easy to drive into most garden soils. Note: Pre-drill holes in the ground to help push them into the ground

【RUST-PROOF】The garden obelisk plant support consists of metal poles with a plastic casing that is rust-proof, the plant support trellis resists sun damage and fading, and is gentle on plant stems. Including an attachable arm to complete the tomato seeder. The vertical tomato obelisk support for indoor gives sturdy support for flowering vines, vegetables.

【A Few Min To Install】 climbing plant supports are equipped with detailed installation instructions. The garden obelisk should be assembled in top-to-bottom order. Fully engaged structure without screws, less time is required on setting up a tomato grid on new plants or established plants

【MULTI-PURPOSE&Garden Focal Point】Perfect for flowering vines like climbing roses, mandevila, clematis, honey suckle , ivy, jasmine and morning glories, as well as vegetable tomato plants, cucumber, gree.They can use garland for holiday decorations and transform any garden into a beautiful floral haven or use fairy lights for a magical nighttime scene for the perfect decorative piece for your yard, garden, or outdoor walkway
